plain_summary: 今天AI圈热闹非凡，B站AI创作赛显示个人创作者正借助AI大放异彩，超八成参赛者是一人团队，说明AI让创作门槛大大降低。GPT-6带火了循环Transformer技术，阿里早已布局，这可能是未来AI的新方向。数学家陶哲轩吐槽GPT-6在数学问题上直接给答案但缺乏推理，提醒我们AI虽强但不能盲信。机器人领域也有新突破，比如世界模型训练后“退场”反而让机器人更能干。另外，微信小微开始内测Agent间沟通，千问办公用户破3000万，AI工具越来越普及。苹果也即将迎来史上最大产品发布潮，可能集成更多AI功能。总之，AI正加速融入创作、办公和日常生活，保持关注，多动手试试，你也能跟上潮流。

top_starred.name: affaan-m/ECC
top_starred.desc: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
top_starred.tagline: 让AI编程助手更聪明、更安全的性能优化系统
top_starred.explanation: 这个工具是给AI编程助手（比如Claude Code、Codex等）用的'外挂'，能提升它们的表现。它解决的是AI在写代码时可能不够高效、容易出错或不够安全的问题。它通过给AI添加'技能'、'直觉'、'记忆'等模块，让AI更懂你的需求。普通人可能用不上，但如果你是程序员，用AI写代码时觉得它不够聪明，可以试试这个。它需要一定的技术背景来安装和配置，但官方提供了详细文档，上手难度中等。

top_starred.name: NousResearch/hermes-agent
top_starred.desc: The agent that grows with you
top_starred.tagline: 能随着你成长而进化的AI助手
top_starred.explanation: 这个项目是一个AI助手框架，特点是'与你一起成长'。它解决的是通用AI助手无法适应个人长期需求的问题。你可以把它想象成一个能不断学习你习惯、偏好和知识的AI伙伴。比如，你每天用它记录工作，它会逐渐了解你的项目背景，给出更贴心的建议。它适合喜欢定制化AI的开发者或高级用户，需要编程知识来部署和训练，但项目提供了教程，有一定难度。

top_starred.name: Significant-Gravitas/AutoGPT
top_starred.desc: AutoGPT is the vision of accessible AI for everyone, to use and to build on. Our mission is to provide the tools, so that you can focus on what matters.
top_starred.tagline: 让每个人都能用的自主AI代理平台
top_starred.explanation: AutoGPT是一个开源项目，目标是让AI能自主完成复杂任务，而不需要一步步指导。比如，你告诉它'帮我研究一下新能源汽车市场'，它会自己搜索、分析、写报告。它解决的是AI只能被动回答问题的问题，让AI成为主动的执行者。普通人也能用，但需要安装Python环境，并了解基本命令行操作。它适合想体验AI自动化的爱好者，上手难度中等，但社区资源丰富。

top_starred.name: ollama/ollama
top_starred.desc: Get up and running with Kimi-K2.6, GLM-5.2, MiniMax, DeepSeek, gpt-oss, Qwen, Gemma and other models.
top_starred.tagline: 一键运行各种大语言模型的本地工具
top_starred.explanation: Ollama是一个让你在个人电脑上轻松运行各种AI大模型（如DeepSeek、Qwen等）的工具。它解决了云端AI依赖网络、隐私泄露和费用高的问题。你下载安装后，只需输入命令就能下载并运行模型，就像安装软件一样简单。普通人可以用它离线聊天、写文章，甚至开发自己的AI应用。它适合所有想本地使用AI的人，安装简单，有图形界面，上手容易。

top_starred.name: firecrawl/firecrawl
top_starred.desc: The context API to search, scrape, and interact with the web at scale. 🔥
top_starred.tagline: 强大的网页抓取和搜索API工具
top_starred.explanation: Firecrawl是一个开发工具，专门用于从网页上提取数据。它解决的是开发者手动爬取网页信息麻烦且容易失败的问题。它提供API，让你输入网址就能得到结构化的数据，比如商品价格、新闻标题等。例如，你可以用它监控竞争对手的价格变动，或者收集行业报告。它适合程序员或数据分析师，需要懂编程，但文档清晰，上手较快。

trending.name: Nanako0129/sepia
trending.desc: De-AI writing skill for any Agent Skills-compatible agent (77+ via the Skills CLI), with native plugins for Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build, and Antigravity. Narrative-architecture repair for fiction, venue-matched rules for professional prose. Based on StoryScope (arXiv:2604.03136).
trending.tagline: 让AI写作更自然、更符合人类风格的技能包
trending.explanation: 这个工具是给AI写作助手（如Claude Code）添加'去AI味'的技能，让AI写出的文章更像人类写的。它解决的是AI写作常常显得生硬、模式化的问题。比如，你写小说时，它会调整叙事结构，让情节更流畅；写专业文章时，它会根据场合调整语气。它适合作家、内容创作者或经常用AI写作的人。安装需要一定技术知识，但项目提供了插件，对非程序员也友好。

trending.name: Player-YN/PawWork_ZhuaZhua
trending.desc: Paw Work - selection-first web agent for Chrome: select on the live page, describe the outcome, take away an editable office file. BYOK, sandboxed, no server.
trending.tagline: 在网页上直接选择内容并生成办公文档的AI工具
trending.explanation: 这是一个Chrome浏览器扩展，让你在浏览网页时，直接用鼠标选择文字或图片，然后AI帮你整理成可编辑的Word或Excel文件。它解决了手动复制粘贴、排版麻烦的问题。比如，你看到一篇好文章，选中关键段落，它就能生成一份摘要文档。它适合需要经常收集资料的学生、研究员或文员。安装简单，无需编程，但需要自带API密钥，上手容易。

trending.name: 2akouwu/reverify
trending.desc: Stop your AI from making things up — it proposes, deterministic tools decide, every claim checked against ground truth with evidence. Grounded facts and context survive resets. Reverse engineering is the proving ground. MCP server + CLI.
trending.tagline: 防止AI胡说八道的验证工具
trending.explanation: 这个工具用于确保AI的回答基于事实，而不是凭空捏造。它解决的是AI经常产生'幻觉'（编造信息）的问题。它通过让AI提出建议，然后用确定性工具验证，并给出证据。比如，你问AI一个历史问题，它会引用可靠来源。它适合对准确性要求高的领域，如法律、医疗。它提供命令行和MCP服务器，需要一定技术背景，但原理简单，适合开发者使用。

trending.name: Human-Agent-Society/reef
trending.desc: Continual learning infra for self-improving agents
trending.tagline: 让AI代理持续学习、自我提升的基础设施
trending.explanation: 这个项目为AI代理提供持续学习的能力，让它们能从经验中不断改进。它解决的是AI代理在完成一次任务后无法积累知识的问题。比如，一个客服AI，通过这个系统，每次解决用户问题后都能学习新话术，下次更高效。它适合研究AI或开发复杂AI系统的团队，需要较强的编程和机器学习知识，上手难度高。

trending.name: OnlyTerp/opengrok
trending.desc: Run any model in Grok Bot — one-command setup, model picker UI, evidence-based provider wire maps, and an update-proof doctor. Not farming you, arming you.
trending.tagline: 在Grok Bot中运行任意AI模型的工具
trending.explanation: 这个工具让你在Grok（一个聊天机器人）中自由切换和运行各种AI模型，而不受限于官方模型。它解决的是Grok只能使用固定模型的问题。它提供一键安装和模型选择界面，让你轻松使用其他模型。比如，你可以把Grok变成用DeepSeek驱动的聊天机器人。它适合喜欢折腾的AI爱好者，需要一些命令行操作，但安装简单，有自动修复功能。

spaces.name: pollen-robotics/microduck-simulator
spaces.tagline: 模拟机器人小鸭子的3D环境，用于训练和测试AI。
spaces.explanation: 这个应用是一个模拟器，提供了一个虚拟的3D环境，里面有一个机器人小鸭子。它的主要作用是让开发者或研究者可以在这个虚拟环境中测试和训练AI算法，比如让AI学会控制小鸭子走路、转弯等。对于普通人或学生来说，你可以把它想象成一个高级的电子宠物游戏，但背后是用于AI研究。比如，你可以用它来学习强化学习的基本概念，通过观察AI如何学会控制小鸭子，直观理解AI的学习过程。上手难度中等，需要一些基本的编程知识，但如果你只是体验，可以运行现成的演示。

spaces.name: kulkas2pintu/wan555
spaces.desc: generate a video from an image with a text prompt
spaces.tagline: 用一张图片和文字生成视频的AI工具。
spaces.explanation: 这个应用可以根据你提供的一张静态图片和一段文字描述，生成一段动态视频。比如，你上传一张风景照，输入“太阳缓缓升起”，它就能生成一个太阳升起的动态视频。对于普通人来说，这可以用于制作有趣的短视频或创意内容。对于学英语的学生，你可以用它来将英语句子可视化，比如输入“a cat jumping over a fence”，生成对应的视频，帮助理解词汇和句子的含义。上手难度低，只需上传图片和输入文字，点击生成即可。

spaces.name: kulkas2pintu/QWEN_EDIT_IMAGE
spaces.desc: Demo of the Collection of Qwen Image Edit LoRAs
spaces.tagline: 用文字指令编辑图片的AI，比如改颜色、加物体。
spaces.explanation: 这个应用基于Qwen模型，允许你用文字指令来编辑图片。比如，你有一张猫的照片，输入“把猫变成蓝色”，它就会修改图片。它解决的是图像编辑需要专业软件和技能的问题。对于普通人，你可以用它来快速修改照片，比如给朋友的照片加上搞笑的元素。对于学英语的学生，你可以用它来练习描述性英语，比如输入“add a red car to the street”，然后看图片变化，加深对词汇的理解。上手难度低，界面友好，只需上传图片并输入指令。

spaces.name: MrdDickDickenson/Krea-2-Turbo_I2I
spaces.desc: Krea 2 Turbo text2image and image editing
spaces.tagline: AI绘画工具，支持文字生成图片和图片编辑。
spaces.explanation: 这个应用是一个AI绘画工具，你可以输入文字描述来生成全新的图片，也可以上传图片进行编辑。比如，输入“一只穿着宇航服的熊猫”，它就能生成这样的图片。对于普通人，这可以用于创作艺术或设计素材。对于学英语的学生，你可以用它来将英语词汇可视化，比如输入“a futuristic city”，生成图片，帮助记忆单词。上手难度低，操作简单，只需输入文字或上传图片。

spaces.name: AimeeBingmouQu/ProtectBirds
spaces.tagline: 保护鸟类的AI应用，可能用于识别或监测。
spaces.explanation: 这个应用名为“保护鸟类”，可能是一个用于识别鸟类或监测鸟类活动的AI工具。由于描述简单，具体功能不明确，但推测可能通过图像识别来帮助人们了解鸟类。对于普通人，你可以用它来拍摄身边的鸟类，然后识别其种类，增加对自然的了解。对于学生，这可以用于生物学习，比如观察不同鸟类的特征。上手难度未知，但通常这类应用会提供简单的拍照识别功能。

models.name: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Vision-Exp
models.tagline: 多模态AI模型，能理解图片和文字。
models.explanation: 这是一个多模态AI模型，可以同时处理图片和文字信息。例如，你可以给它一张图片并提问“图片里有什么？”，它能回答。它解决的是让AI理解视觉内容的问题。对于普通人，你可以用它来识别照片中的物体或场景。对于学英语的学生，你可以用它来练习描述图片，比如上传一张图片，让它用英语描述，然后你学习其中的词汇和句型。上手难度中等，需要一些编程知识来调用API，但也可以通过在线演示体验。

models.name: Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B
models.tagline: 强大的多模态模型，能看图说话、回答问题。
models.explanation: 这是Qwen系列的多模态模型，可以理解图片和文字，并生成回答。比如，你给它一张数学题图片，它能解答。它解决的是让AI具备视觉理解能力的问题。对于普通人，你可以用它来识别物品、翻译图片中的文字等。对于学生，你可以用它来辅助学习，比如上传一张历史图片，让它讲解背景。上手难度中等，需要编程调用，但可能提供在线演示。

models.name: XHToken/Spark-X2.5-4B
models.tagline: 轻量级文本生成模型，用于对话和写作。
models.explanation: 这是一个文本生成模型，专注于生成自然语言文本。它可以用于聊天机器人、写作辅助等。比如，你可以让它写一篇短文或回答你的问题。它解决的是自动生成文本的需求。对于普通人，你可以用它来写邮件或故事。对于学英语的学生，你可以用它来练习写作，比如给它一个主题，让它生成范文，然后你学习。上手难度中等，需要编程知识，但可能提供简单的API。

models.name: google/timesfm-3.0-pytorch
models.tagline: 预测时间序列的AI，比如预测天气或股票。
models.explanation: 这是一个时间序列预测模型，专门用于预测未来数据点，比如天气变化、股票价格、销售额等。它解决的是基于历史数据预测未来的问题。对于普通人，你可以用它来预测未来几天的气温，但需要数据。对于学生，你可以用它来学习数据分析，比如用历史销售数据预测下月销量。上手难度较高，需要数据处理和编程技能。

models.name: Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next
models.tagline: 快速的多模态模型，能处理图片和文字。
models.explanation: 这是Qwen系列的一个快速版本，同样能处理图片和文字。它可能比完整版更快，适合实时应用。比如，你可以用它来实时识别摄像头中的物体。它解决的是对速度有要求的场景。对于普通人，你可以用它来快速获取图片信息。对于学生，你可以用它来练习英语口语，比如对着摄像头说英语，它识别并回应。上手难度中等，需要编程调用。

items.title_en: Compile by Training: Turning Natural-Language Specifications into Local Neural Functions
items.summary: Many recurring text functions are easy to describe but difficult to implement with rules, while calling a large remote model for every input introduces repeated cost, latency, and dependency on a provider. We present compile by training, which turns a natural-language specification into a reusable neural function. At compile time, teacher models generate task-specific examples that are used to train a small adapter for a compact interpreter. The resulting function runs without the teachers and c
items.title_cn: 通过训练编译：将自然语言规范转化为本地神经函数
items.note: 研究将自然语言描述转化为可复用的本地小模型，减少调用大模型的成本，对AI应用优化有启发。

items.title_en: Terminal-Universe: Turning Agent Trajectories into Scalable Terminal Environments
items.summary: As terminal-based code agents become prevalent, agent trajectories have accumulated at scale, while realistic, executable environments remain scarce. However, environments are what agent post-training actually requires: each can be re-queried into many verifiable tasks and provides execution feedback, whereas a trajectory is a single frozen demonstration. Rather than generating environments from scratch, we observe that the tool-execution history in existing trajectories exposes the structure an
items.title_cn: 终端宇宙：将智能体轨迹转化为可扩展的终端环境
items.note: 利用现有智能体轨迹构建可执行环境，用于训练和评估，对智能体发展有重要意义。

items.title_en: LLaDA-Image: Building Strong Image Generators with Fully Open Training Recipes
items.summary: We introduce LLaDA-Image, a unified framework that pairs a 6B Diffusion Transformer (DiT) trained from scratch with a frozen vision-language understanding module built on the LLaDA2.0-Mini diffusion language model backbone. Instead of relying heavily on paired image-text data from the beginning, we first build a strong visual generative prior through image-only pre-training and mid-training. The generation pipeline comprises 220M samples, 98 of which are real images. For efficient and scalable o
items.title_cn: LLaDA-Image：构建具有完全开放训练流程的强大图像生成器
items.note: 介绍了一个开源图像生成模型，强调训练流程的开放性，适合关注生成模型的新手了解。

items.title_en: Random Attention: Rethinking KV Cache Eviction for Efficient Reasoning
items.summary: Large language models achieve superior performance on tasks that require extended reasoning, but long chains of thought make the KV cache a severe memory bottleneck. Existing KV cache compression methods share one paradigm: score each cached token by some estimate of how much it will matter later, and keep the top-scoring ones. We show that the selection signal contributes almost nothing. Random Attention keeps the prompt and evicts uniformly at random within each attention head, computing no sc
items.title_cn: 随机注意力：重新思考KV缓存驱逐以实现高效推理
items.note: 发现KV缓存压缩中随机选择与复杂评分效果相当，简化方法，对推理效率提升有参考价值。

items.title_en: Knowing When Not to Reuse: Conditional Experience Transfer in Autonomous LLM Post-Training
items.summary: Large language models offer broad capabilities, but adapting them to evolving domains, tools, and requirements often entails repeated post-training. Autonomous systems automate parts of this process by proposing updates, training candidates, and using evaluation feedback to select subsequent proposals. As evidence accumulates, a central problem emerges: which past update evidence remains actionable after subsequent training has changed the parent model? An update's effect depends on its parent,
items.title_cn: 知道何时不复用：自主LLM后训练中的条件经验迁移
items.note: 探讨在LLM后训练中如何判断历史经验是否有效，对自动化训练有指导意义。

items.title_en: Repo-To-Skill: Distilling GitHub Repositories Into AI4AI Skills
items.summary: Autonomous agents are beginning to carry out machine-learning (ML) research end to end. These agents combine a model backbone with a harness for planning, execution, memory, and verification, but this architecture still leaves domain-specific know-how outside the agent. We call this missing layer operational knowledge, the know-how that separates knowing a method from making it work. That knowledge is not absent from the field. It appears in repositories and papers, but in forms written for huma
items.title_cn: 仓库到技能：将GitHub仓库提炼为AI4AI技能
items.note: 从GitHub仓库提取可复用的操作知识，帮助AI代理掌握领域技能，对AI自动化研究有启发。

items.title_en: HarnessDev: Can LLMs Create and Evolve Their Own Agent Harness?
items.summary: As agents move from research prototypes to deployed tools, their capability increasingly depends on model-external execution infrastructure, commonly termed the agent harness. Changing this harness while holding model weights fixed can substantially alter task performance. Current agent evaluations typically report downstream performance under a chosen harness, leaving a model's ability to develop the harness itself comparatively underexplored. We introduce HarnessDev, a benchmark that shifts th
items.title_cn: HarnessDev：LLM能否创建并进化自己的代理框架？
items.note: 研究LLM能否自主设计代理的执行框架，评估其自我改进能力，对智能体发展有前瞻性。

items.title_en: Aspire: Can Models Self-Evolve from Vague Goals?
items.summary: Many important forms of human learning begin with a vague goal, such as "become a better physicist" or "improve at research." Learners must interpret the goal, identify capability gaps, decide how to learn, and determine whether they have actually improved. In contrast, existing work on LLM self-evolution typically begins with tasks and evaluation metrics specified by humans, reducing self-evolution to optimizing an explicit objective rather than deciding what and how to learn. We introduce ASPI
items.title_cn: Aspire：模型能否从模糊目标中自我进化？
items.note: 探索LLM在模糊目标下自主设定学习任务的能力，对自我进化研究有参考价值。

items.title_en: SolarWM: Open Data and Scalable Training for Long-Horizon Video World Models
items.summary: We introduce SolarWM, a fully open foundation for building interactive video world models from data preparation through long-horizon inference. Training across heterogeneous data sources and video backbones is challenging: datasets differ in temporal scale, camera geometry, visual quality, motion, and captioning styles, while video generators use distinct representations and architectures. Naive data mixing and model-specific implementations therefore produce inconsistent supervision and make re
items.title_cn: SolarWM：用于长时程视频世界模型的开放数据与可扩展训练
items.note: 提出开放的视频世界模型训练框架，处理多源数据，对视频生成与预测有贡献。

items.title_en: EarlyEval: Cheaper Agent Evaluation via Early Outcome Prediction
items.summary: Evaluating LLM agents is essential for guiding their development, yet it has grown prohibitively expensive: a single pass of a frontier model over an agentic benchmark can cost hundreds to thousands of dollars, a price paid repeatedly across iterative development cycles. Prior efforts, centered on benchmark distillation, reduce the number of evaluation tasks but leave the cost of executing each retained task untouched. In this work, we introduce early outcome prediction, a complementary axis of
items.title_cn: EarlyEval：通过早期结果预测实现更廉价的智能体评估
items.note: 通过预测早期结果减少评估成本，对智能体评估效率有实际意义。

items.title_en: StudentSim: Training LLM-based Student Simulators
items.summary: AI tutors are most useful when they adapt to each student's strengths, weaknesses, and preferred guidance, but evidence about which guidance works for which student is sparse, slow, and costly to collect from real learners. Student simulators can provide this signal as a proxy, yet existing approaches are limited: state-tracking models fit student behavior but struggle to process explanations or corrections, while LLM role-play follows guidance fluently but does not reliably match the competence
items.title_cn: StudentSim：训练基于LLM的学生模拟器
items.note: 构建学生模拟器以辅助AI教学，需平衡行为拟合与语言流畅，对教育AI有应用价值。

items.title_en: Qwen-Drive-1.0: An Initial Step towards a Vision-Language Foundation Model for Autonomous Driving
items.summary: We present Qwen-Drive-1.0, an initial step towards a vision-language foundation model for autonomous driving. Qwen-Drive-1.0 retains the architecture of the pretrained vision-language model (VLM) and integrates 3D perception, visual question answering, and motion planning within a unified framework. An external bird's-eye-view (BEV) perception head jointly performs 3D object detection, semantic occupancy prediction, and BEV map segmentation. It serves as a probe of the 3D information accessible
items.title_cn: Qwen-Drive-1.0：迈向自动驾驶视觉语言基础模型的初步探索
items.note: 提出自动驾驶的视觉语言模型，整合感知与规划，对自动驾驶AI有参考。

items.title_en: SMELT: Scaling Laws for Compute-Matched MoE Looped Transformers
items.summary: Looped Transformers increase effective depth by iterating a shared block of layers, but most evaluations compare at fixed model size, conflating architectural advantage with extra FLOPs. We study looping on Mixture-of-Experts Transformers while closely matching per-token FLOPs, total non-embedding parameters, and KV cache. Through a series of ablations, we arrive at a recipe we call SMELT (Sparse MoE Transformer, middle layers Loop Twice), which loops the middle half of layers twice while matchi
items.title_cn: SMELT：计算匹配的MoE循环Transformer的缩放定律
items.note: 研究MoE循环Transformer的缩放规律，优化模型设计，对架构理解有帮助。

items.title_en: UI-Venus-2 Technical Report
items.summary: Multimodal GUI agents have emerged as a promising paradigm for digital task automation, yet transitioning from benchmark-oriented models to dependable real-world applications remains challenging due to limited environment coverage, brittle task construction, and unreliable reward verification. In this work, we present UI-Venus-2, a general-purpose foundation GUI agent designed to operate across mobile, web, and desktop environments through a unified closed-loop reasoning-action framework. To bri
items.title_cn: UI-Venus-2技术报告
items.note: 介绍跨平台GUI智能体，统一移动、网页和桌面操作，对自动化任务有应用前景。

items.title_en: ZimaBlue: Evolving Generalizable World Action Models through Scalable Video Pre-training
items.summary: Robotic manipulation faces a fundamental scaling challenge: robust generalization demands broad physical experience, yet action-labeled robot trajectories are expensive to collect and inherently limited in diversity. Egocentric videos offer a far more scalable source of embodied experience, capturing object interactions, contact dynamics, tool use, and long-horizon behaviors across diverse environments. The central challenge is how to convert this abundant but action-free experience into effecti
items.title_cn: ZimaBlue：通过可扩展视频预训练进化通用世界动作模型
items.note: 利用第一视角视频预训练机器人操作模型，解决数据稀缺问题，对机器人学习有启发。

items.title_en: Does On-Policy Distillation Really Distill? From Noisy Teacher to Self-Improvement
items.summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) offers dense token-level supervision as an alternative to the sparse outcome-level advantages of reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). However, the teacher scores student-generated trajectories that are inherently off-policy for it, so the reliability of its supervision, and hence the source of the student's improvement, remains unclear. We quantitatively analyze teacher supervision during OPD training and find substantial noise whose prevalence incr
items.title_cn: 在线策略蒸馏真的有效吗？从噪声教师到自我改进
items.note: 分析在线策略蒸馏中的噪声问题，探讨其有效性，对训练方法有批判性思考。

items.title_en: Lucida: Parse, Generate, and Place for Composable Real-to-Sim Scene Modeling
items.summary: Composable scene modeling aims to recover a real indoor scene as complete, editable object assets arranged as observed, giving robot simulation and embodied AI a simulation-ready replica of the real environment whose objects can be manipulated individually. Existing pipelines decompose the task into three steps---parse the observations into instances, generate an asset for each, and place each asset back---but every step presumes an input that a cluttered capture rarely provides: accurate instan
items.title_cn: Lucida：用于可组合真实到模拟场景建模的解析、生成与放置
items.note: 提出从真实场景恢复可编辑对象资产的方法，用于仿真，对机器人模拟有应用。

items.title_en: DreamX-Creator: Democratizing Native Audio-Video Generation at 2K Resolution
items.summary: Recent video generators often omit audio or synthesize it in a separate stage, limiting reciprocal modeling of visual dynamics and acoustic events. We present DreamX-Creator 1.0, a compact native joint audio-video generation system centered on a 7B generator. Conditioned on a first frame and a text prompt, the generator jointly denoises modality-specialized audio and video streams. The streams are processed independently in the first half of the network and coupled in the latter half through Gat
items.title_cn: DreamX-Creator：实现2K分辨率的原生音视频生成民主化
items.note: 介绍联合生成音频和视频的模型，降低生成成本，对多媒体生成有贡献。

items.title_en: GenFirst: Generation Before Reconstruction for Stable End-to-End Latent Generative Modeling
items.summary: Latent generative models typically follow a two-stage pipeline, training a variational autoencoder for reconstruction and then a generative model on the frozen latent space. Since reconstruction-optimized latents are not necessarily generation-friendly, jointly training both models is an appealing alternative. However, direct end-to-end training remains challenging, as it is prone to latent collapse and faces a generation-reconstruction conflict. We revisit this problem by analyzing how differen
items.title_cn: GenFirst：先生成后重建的稳定端到端潜在生成建模
items.note: 提出先训练生成模型再重建的端到端方法，避免潜在崩溃，对生成模型训练有创新。

items.title_en: On the Design of Qwen3.8-Next Architecture: Evaluation, Efficiency, and Training Stability
items.summary: We describe the architecture and ablations of Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, a sparse mixture-of-experts model with 125B parameters, 6B activated per token, and additional 51B parameters of n-gram embedding tables held off the accelerator. On fourteen pre-training benchmarks the model leads the 397B-A17B predecessor on eight and trails it on the rest by at most 2.6 points, at 1/3 the activated parameters, 1/3 the training tokens, and roughly 1/9 the training FLOPs. Token mixing uses a layer-wise hybrid of
items.title_cn: Qwen3.8-Next架构设计：评估、效率与训练稳定性
items.note: 介绍Qwen3.8-Next的架构与消融实验，展示高效稀疏MoE设计，对模型优化有参考。

items.title_en: LoopArena: Benchmarking Models as Runtime Controllers for Loop Engineering
items.summary: Loop Engineering is emerging as a practice for organizing development work around coding agents. Instead of writing each prompt by hand, practitioners design loops that monitor progress, assign work, run checks, and decide what the agent should do next. Even with a capable coding agent, a loop may trust a stale progress note, skip needed verification, spend its budget in the wrong direction, or stop before the task is safe to submit. Yet the final outcome of one end-to-end run cannot tell whethe
items.title_cn: LoopArena：将模型作为循环工程的运行时控制器进行基准测试
items.note: 评估模型在编码代理循环中的控制能力，对智能体开发流程有指导意义。

items.title_en: Beyond Data Scaling: Representation-Centric Continued Pre-training for Vision-Language-Action Models
items.summary: Scaling robot data is crucial for building generalist Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, yet robot trajectories are harder to scale than web-scale image-text data because embodied collection is costly and sparsely covers the physical world. This makes representation quality a central bottleneck: under a fixed robot-data budget, continued pre-training must turn limited trajectories into transferable visual-action knowledge rather than merely fit actions. We propose VLAct, a VLA-oriented VLM bac
items.title_cn: 超越数据扩展：面向视觉-语言-动作模型的表征中心持续预训练
items.note: 强调表征质量在机器人数据有限时的重要性，提出VLAct方法，对VLA模型有贡献。

items.title_en: DART-SD: Diamond-topology Aware Retrieval and Tuning for Self-Distillation of Multi-Turn Tool-Calling Agents
items.summary: Equipping Large Language Models (LLMs) with multi-turn tool-calling capabilities is essential for building autonomous agents. However, progress is fundamentally limited by the reliance on full-length trajectory imitation. For tasks involving multiple order-independent sub-goals, the optimal solution space forms a vast combinatorial diamond lattice. Forcing this rich topology into monolithic trajectories causes a severe topological collapse, indiscriminately penalizing valid alternative explorati
items.title_cn: DART-SD：用于多轮工具调用智能体自蒸馏的菱形拓扑感知检索与调优
items.note: 解决多轮工具调用中的拓扑崩溃问题，通过自蒸馏提升性能，对智能体训练有创新。

items.title_en: Agentic Artifact Creation: Systems, Evaluation, Principles, and Opportunities
items.summary: Generative models can turn natural-language prompts into images, text, code, and other content, lowering the cost of producing drafts and components. Their practical impact increasingly depends on whether those pieces can become complete, dependable deliverables. This survey examines agentic artifact creation, which we define as stateful construction in which an AI system materially constructs or revises a deliverable and intermediate observations redirect later work. Functionally, the process l
items.title_cn: 代理工件创建：系统、评估、原则与机遇
items.note: 综述AI系统创建完整交付物的研究，定义代理工件创建，对AI应用有全景认识。

items.title_en: Code as Worlds: Agentic Discovery of Executable World Representations for Physical Reasoning
items.summary: Physical understanding and reasoning depend on forming compact and generalizable representations of the world. While modern vision-language models can recognize and explain diverse physical events, they often lack explicit representations of the underlying mechanisms-such as object states, physical parameters, and governing dynamics-needed for reliably reasoning how the world evolves and responds to interventions. In this work, we introduce Code-as-World, a paradigm that represents physical worl
items.title_cn: 代码即世界：用于物理推理的可执行世界表征的代理发现
items.note: 用代码表示物理世界，便于推理和干预，对物理推理研究有新颖视角。

items.title_en: Agentic Game Development as a Verifiable Trajectory Data Engine for Scaling World Models
items.summary: A common strategy for scaling world models is to train on more crawled video with more compute. We argue that this strategy is inefficient: scaling world models also requires a recursive data engine that offers grounded reward signals. The success of code agents illustrates why this matters. As code is executable, compilers and runtimes can provide high-quality rewards for Reinforcement Learning (RL) post-training of LLMs. By contrast, spatial generation still relies largely on fuzzy proxies suc
items.title_cn: 代理游戏开发作为可验证轨迹数据引擎以扩展世界模型
items.note: 利用游戏开发提供可验证数据，用于训练世界模型，对世界模型扩展有创新。

items.title_en: PAWBench: How Far Are We from Probabilistically Aligned World Modeling?
items.summary: Recent video generation models are increasingly framed as world models. Many physical processes can unfold in more than one valid way. Therefore, a world model should reproduce not only a plausible trajectory, but also the distribution of possible behaviors under the same initial observation and action. We call this distribution-level requirement probabilistic alignment. However, existing evaluations largely assess individual-video plausibility and do not test whether repeated generations recove
items.title_cn: PAWBench：我们在概率对齐世界建模方面走了多远？
items.note: 提出评估世界模型概率对齐的基准，强调分布一致性，对世界模型评估有贡献。

items.title_en: UrbanGround: From Local Perception to Spatial Agency in a Real-Scale City
items.summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can interpret a street view, but urban agency depends on whether such local evidence remains useful after the agent starts to move. In this paper, we investigate how far current MLLM agents can turn local urban perception into reliable action in a complicated real-scale city. We propose UrbanGround, the first sandbox to make this question testable in a physically constrained replica of Hong Kong built from territory-wide 3D geospatial data. UrbanGround su
items.title_cn: UrbanGround：从局部感知到真实尺度城市中的空间代理
items.note: 构建香港真实尺度沙盒，测试多模态LLM在复杂城市中的导航能力，对具身AI有应用。

items.title_en: TTPO: Test-Time Policy Optimization
items.summary: Recent prominent post-training methods, such as Reinforcement Learning (RL) and On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD), have driven rapid progress in mathematical reasoning for large language models, yet their reliance on ground-truth labels precludes test-time training (TTT). Replacing ground truth with majority-vote pseudo-labels is a natural alternative, yet it is fragile: an incorrect vote corrupts the teacher and misleads every token. We observe that this failure mode is asymmetric: rollouts th
items.title_cn: TTPO：测试时策略优化
items.note: 提出无需真实标签的测试时训练方法，利用多数投票伪标签，对推理训练有创新。

items.title_en: Self-OPD: On-Policy Distillation for Flow Matching Models without Teacher
items.summary: On-policy distillation (OPD), which leverages a pre-trained, specialized teacher model to provide dense supervisory signals, has achieved significant success in Large Language Models (LLMs) and has recently been adapted to flow matching models. However, this paradigm suffers from two major issues: First, training a separate, task-specific teacher for every new objective incurs high computational costs. Second, the discrepancy between teacher and student distributions often leads to compounding e
items.title_cn: Self-OPD：无教师的流匹配模型在线策略蒸馏
items.note: 改进在线策略蒸馏，无需单独教师模型，降低成本，对生成模型训练有贡献。

items.title_en: VBVR-Pro: A Scalable and Verifiable Suite for Native Visual Reasoning
items.summary: Native visual reasoning treats visual generation as the medium of reasoning itself: visual states (i.e. images and videos) are not merely inputs to be understood or outputs to be rendered, but first-class substrates for problem solving beyond language. Yet progress remains bottlenecked by the lack of scalable training tasks, reliable feedback, and controlled comparisons across generative substrates. In this work, we introduce VBVR-Pro, a closed-loop testbed that makes native visual reasoning thr
items.title_cn: VBVR-Pro：用于原生视觉推理的可扩展可验证套件
items.note: 提供视觉推理的测试平台，支持可验证任务，对视觉推理研究有工具价值。

items.title_en: VGI-Bench: Probing Visual Intelligence in Video Generation Models
items.summary: Recent studies suggest that video generation models can exhibit certain forms of zero-shot visual reasoning through generated frames. Yet reliable evaluation remains challenging: benchmarks should adopt inputs aligned with the visual priors of current video models, require valid evolving processes rather than only plausible final states, and calibrate task difficulty to remain challenging yet partly feasible. To this end, we introduce VGI-bench, containing 27 tasks and 810 instances, organized b
items.title_cn: VGI-Bench：探究视频生成模型中的视觉智能
items.note: 设计基准测试视频生成模型的零样本推理能力，对评估视频模型有参考。

items.title_en: VoiceMem: Streaming Dual-Brain Memory for Real-Time Interaction
items.summary: Conversational systems, such as duplex speech language models (SLMs), still lack a streaming, accurate, and empathetic memory system as their soul. We introduce VoiceMem, a simple memory architecture with a parallel informational left brain, an emotional right brain, and streaming memory I/O mechanisms. We further build a complete pipeline for memory-aware SLM training, long-horizon evaluation, and decoupled deployment with interchangeable memory backends. Experiments and real-world deployment s
items.title_cn: VoiceMem：用于实时交互的流式双脑记忆
items.note: 提出双脑记忆架构增强语音对话系统的记忆能力，对交互系统有应用。

items.title_en: FrontierChallenge: Evaluating Scientific Workflow Completion
items.summary: Scientific agents increasingly analyze data, execute code, and produce research artifacts, yet most benchmarks emphasize final answers, isolated programs, or a single domain. We introduce FrontierChallenge, a cross-domain benchmark comprising 300 end-to-end scientific workflows. In this paper, we release and evaluate 97 of these tasks, spanning quantum chemistry, molecular dynamics, materials characterization, analytical chemistry, life science, and electrochemistry/environment. Each task provid
items.title_cn: FrontierChallenge：评估科学工作流完成情况
items.note: 发布跨领域科学工作流基准，测试智能体完成复杂任务的能力，对科学自动化有贡献。

items.title_en: WarpSAC: Towards the Pinnacle of Scalable Off-policy RL by Rethinking Exploration and Exploitation
items.summary: Massively parallel simulation changes the data regime in which off-policy reinforcement learning (RL) is trained, challenging stabilizers designed for data-limited replay. Through controlled experiments across eight benchmark families, we show that these stabilizers are data-regime-dependent: parameter normalization helps with narrow replay coverage but restricts value fitting when data are abundant, while clipped double-Q can be relaxed in high-throughput manipulation. Age-biased replay weighti
items.title_cn: WarpSAC：通过重新思考探索与利用实现可扩展离策略RL的巅峰
items.note: 研究大规模并行模拟下离策略RL的稳定器，提出改进方法，对强化学习有参考。

huggingface.models_summary: 这些热门模型反映了AI正朝着多模态（同时理解文字和图片）和专业化（如时间序列预测）方向发展。对于想跟进AI圈的人，要注意多模态能力是趋势，比如DeepSeek和Qwen的模型都能看图说话。备考AI方向的话，要关注模型如何融合不同数据类型，以及如何高效推理。同时，轻量级模型（如Spark-X2.5）也值得注意，说明AI正在向低资源设备普及。
huggingface.papers_summary: 这批论文主要围绕AI智能体、世界模型、生成模型和训练方法展开。热门方向包括：让AI自主学习和进化、构建可交互的世界模拟器、提升视频和图像生成能力、优化模型训练效率。备考新手应记住的关键词有：智能体（Agent）、世界模型（World Model）、扩散模型（Diffusion Model）、在线策略蒸馏（On-Policy Distillation）、MoE架构、视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）等。
